headline.en: Kosdaq gaps down 3.26% to 727.21 and KOSPI drops to 5,469.47, a seven-month low, as foreigners sell ₩695.5bn; Wall Street rebounds on Anthropic's IPO filing. Two of three nails lit, biotech gate shut.

The data snapshot of 27 Oct 08:02 KST has no failed fetches, but the 10Y and USD/KRW series end 23 Oct and Brent ends 20 Oct, so the nails are read on lagged data. Press on 26 Oct: the 10-year at 4.986% (Yahoo Finance, not the Treasury par yield) and WTI December futures at $101.34; an exact Brent close was not found (updates ranged ~$110–112). Seoul FX close 1,323.10 (Newspim, 15:42 KST). Snapshot 26 Oct: SPY +0.71%, XBI +0.62%, EWY +0.97%, TLT +0.42%, UUP +0.17%. FOMC decision 28 Oct (meeting 27–28 Oct).

FOMC는 10/27~28일, 결정은 10/28.

stance.en: Defensive — rally is a headline bounce ahead of the 28 Oct FOMC

note.en: S&P 500 +0.70% to 7,676.77, Nasdaq Composite +0.82% to 26,169.38 and the Dow +0.28% to 52,361.58 after Anthropic's public S-1 filing revived AI names; oil eased from recent highs but stayed elevated on Middle East tensions (Yahoo Finance, 26 Oct close). Markets expect a hold at the FOMC, with a hawkish tone flagged. Alphabet and Microsoft report 28 Oct. Snapshot: SPY +0.71%, XBI +0.62%, EWY +0.97%.

stance.en: Cash — wait for foreign flow to turn

note.en: Kosdaq −24.48pt (−3.26%) to 727.21 on 26 Oct, its lowest in about three months; institutions net sold ₩127.9bn against foreign buying of ₩40.2bn and individual buying of ₩85.4bn (Seoul Shinmun, 15:55 KST; Newspim's figures, which include NXT, differ slightly). Losses were concentrated in biotech and chip-equipment names. KOSPI −80.83pt (−1.46%) to 5,469.47, the lowest close since 6 April, with foreigners net selling ₩695.5bn, institutions buying ₩611.0bn and individuals ₩47.4bn (Seoul Shinmun, 15:57 KST); 792 stocks fell vs 101 up. USD/KRW 1,323.10 at the Seoul close (Newspim). EWY +0.97% in New York overnight.
note.kr: 10/26 코스닥 727.21(−24.48p, −3.26%)로 약 3개월 만의 최저. 기관 −1,279억을 외국인 +402억·개인 +854억이 받음(서울신문 15:55; NXT 포함 집계인 뉴스핌 수치와는 소폭 차이). 바이오·반도체 장비주 낙폭 집중. 코스피는 5,469.47(−80.83p, −1.46%)로 4월 6일 이후 최저 마감, 외국인 −6,955억·기관 +6,110억·개인 +474억(서울신문 15:57), 하락 792종목 대 상승 101종목. 서울 외환시장 마감 원/달러 1,323.10원(뉴스핌). 간밤 뉴욕에서 EWY +0.97%.

note.en: The 10-year sits just under 5%, oil is far above its level three months ago, Kosdaq lost 3.26% to 727.21 with biotech leading the decline (HLB −5.65%), and foreigners sold KOSPI again. XBI +0.62% in the US snapshot is not enough to offset. Nothing has flipped.
note.kr: 10년물은 5% 턱밑, 유가는 3개월 전보다 크게 높고, 코스닥은 바이오가 낙폭을 주도하며(HLB −5.65%) 3.26% 급락한 727.21, 외국인은 코스피에서 또 순매도. 미국 XBI +0.62%로는 상쇄되지 않는다. 뒤집힌 조건은 없다.

read.en: Wall Street shrugged off oil and yields on a single AI headline, but Seoul did not follow: KOSPI hit a seven-month low on ₩695.5bn of foreign selling, and Kosdaq's 3.26% drop was led by biotech and chip equipment at thin turnover of about ₩9tn. With the 10-year at roughly 5% and Brent still above $100, the FOMC on 28 Oct is a hawkish-pause risk rather than a relief catalyst. Foreigners were small net buyers of Kosdaq (₩40.2bn) while institutions sold, so the board has no committed buyer. The won at 1,323 remains the one supportive variable; until foreign flow on KOSPI turns and oil eases, rebounds in Korean biotech read as position squaring.
read.kr: 뉴욕은 유가·금리 부담을 AI 재료 하나로 털어냈지만 서울은 따라가지 못했다. 코스피는 외국인 6,955억 원 순매도에 7개월 최저로 밀렸고, 코스닥은 거래대금 9조 원 안팎의 얇은 장에서 바이오·반도체 장비가 낙폭을 키우며 3.26% 급락했다. 10년물이 5% 안팎, Brent가 여전히 100달러를 웃도는 가운데 10/28 FOMC는 완화 기대의 재료라기보다 '매파적 동결' 리스크에 가깝다. 코스닥은 외국인이 402억 원 소폭 순매수했지만 기관이 던지고 있어 확실한 매수 주체가 없다. 1,323원대 원화가 유일한 우군이며, 코스피 외국인 수급이 돌아서고 유가가 꺾이기 전까지 국내 바이오 반등은 포지션 정리로 보는 편이 합리적이다.
